recon.variance_source: nalytical,Tallahassee,FL,USA),while the least significant difference (LSD)test at 5%probability was used to
recon.treatment_definition: T2 = seed priming with 0.3% ZnSO4; T3 = soil application of 50 kg ZnSO4 per ha; T4 = foliar application of 0.5% ZnSO4; T5 = soil + foliar application combined
recon.sample_size_source: The experiment was laid out in a randomized complete block design in a factorial arrangement with three replications
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain Zn concentration data from Tables 2 and 3. In Table 2, extract main effects comparing T2, T3, T4, T5 each against T1 control. Use LSD values for variance. Extract data for both years separately (2013-2014 and 2014-2015). Table 3 shows interactive effects - can extract cultivar-specific responses if needed. Target outcome is 'Grain zinc concentration (mg kg−1)' - ignore grain yield and phytic acid data.
